[[Awakened Gray Giant]]s are [[undead]] raised by [[Palawa Joko]] to serve in his army centuries ago when he tried to conquer all of [[Elona]].

When an Awakened Gray Giant receives a [[critical hit]], it will spawn an [[Awakened Head]]. Awakened Gray Giants pressure energy and interrupt spell casting, but have a low damage output.

==Notes==
*It is suspected that they lose their head with either the skill {{skill icon|Lose your Head}} or {{skill icon|Wandering Mind}}.
*When [[resurrection|resurrected]] after losing their head, they will stay headless.
*When they lose their head, it seems that the game actually creates both a new Awakened Head and a new headless Awakened Gray Giant; this could explain why their skills recharge.
